description: Pass 1 Operational Semantics Specification for Arm Mali Valhall ISA (v9-v14) -> ValhallSSA

rules.comment: FABS aliases FADD with abs0 already set in hardware encoding; get_src_abs suppresses abs0 on src0 so FAbs is emitted once.
FNEG aliases FADD with neg0 already set in hardware encoding; get_src_neg suppresses neg0 on src0 so FNeg is emitted once.
Valhall CUBEFACE1(x,y,z) returns f32 major-axis magnitude max(|x|,|y|,|z|).
Valhall CUBEFACE2(x,y,z) returns u32 face index (0..5) packed in bits [31:29] (face << 29).
Valhall CUBE_SSEL(Z, X, face_word): face 0 (+X) -> -Z, face 1 (-X) -> +Z, faces 2/3/4 -> +X, face 5 (-Z) -> -X.
Valhall CUBE_TSEL(Y, Z, face_word): face 2 (+Y) -> +Z, face 3 (-Y) -> -Z, faces 0/1/4/5 -> -Y.
MUX.i32 dispatches on muxf: bit, int_zero, neg, fp_zero.
MUX.v2i16 applies muxf per 16-bit half-word lane.
MUX.v4i8 applies muxf per 8-bit byte lane.
LD_PKA loads from packed buffer descriptor src1 at 32-bit byte offset src0; abi::psb_load(is_pka=true) resolves src1 to buffer base.
